current_source_capture.positive_record_semantics: A typed source record supports recorded administration during ICU hours 0-24.

intended_target_trial.eligible_population: Adult ICU stays eligible for either strategy at ICU admission, with source-complete medication capture, valid admission timing, and prespecified baseline covariates defined at or before ICU-admission time zero.
intended_target_trial.followup: From ICU admission through 28 days, in-hospital death, discharge alive, or administrative data end, whichever occurs first.
intended_target_trial.outcome: 28-day cumulative incidence of in-hospital death with discharge alive treated as a competing event.
intended_target_trial.estimand: Per-protocol 28-day risk difference and risk ratio for initiation within 24 hours versus verified non-initiation within 24 hours in the overlap-eligible target population.
intended_target_trial.censoring_and_competing_events: Artificially censor strategy deviations under cloning; estimate stabilized inverse-probability-of-censoring weights using prespecified baseline and time-varying adherence information, treat discharge alive as competing, and report artificial and administrative censoring separately.

reportability_rule: With the current inputevents-derived contract, report the structured H2_VERIFIED_NON_USE_UNAVAILABLE feasibility result and do not emit a treatment-effect estimate. A causal contrast becomes eligible only after a separately reviewed source contract proves both administration capture and verified non-use.
